name: External payment provider issue
description: An external payment provider (e.g. PayGate) times out, returns 5xx or rejects credentials, so card payments fail.

fallback_hypothesis.title: Degradation on the external payment provider side
fallback_hypothesis.reasoning: Matched keywords point to failing calls from payment-service to an external payment provider.
next_steps: Check the provider status page and recent provider notifications.
In ELK, compare the error and timeout rate of payment-service calls per provider since the incident start.
Verify that provider credentials and certificates used by payment-service have not expired or been rotated.

name: DB degradation caused by reporting
description: Long analytical queries from reporting-service overload PostgreSQL, slowing down transactional endpoints.

fallback_hypothesis.title: Heavy reporting queries saturate the shared database
fallback_hypothesis.reasoning: Matched keywords point to database load and slow responses, a known pattern caused by reporting-service.
next_steps: Inspect pg_stat_activity for long-running queries and their client application.
Compare DB CPU and IO graphs with reporting-service job schedules.
Check p95 latency of /payments/create and api-gateway 504 rate on the same timeline.

name: Notification delivery issue
description: notification-service cannot deliver e-mail or SMS because of SMTP/SMS provider problems, while core flows work.

fallback_hypothesis.title: External SMTP/SMS provider is failing
fallback_hypothesis.reasoning: Matched keywords point to notification delivery, which depends on external SMTP/SMS providers.
next_steps: In ELK, filter notification-service logs for connection and delivery errors by provider.
Check the SMTP/SMS provider status page and account quotas.
Check the notification-service outbound queue size and retry backlog.

name: User authentication errors
description: Users cannot log in or get 401 responses because auth-service rejects tokens or credentials.

fallback_hypothesis.title: Token signing or validation mismatch in auth-service
fallback_hypothesis.reasoning: Matched keywords point to authentication failures such as 401 responses or invalid token signatures.
next_steps: In ELK, check auth-service 401 rate and the token validation error messages.
Verify that signing keys or JWKS were not rotated without updating all consumers.
Check recent auth-service and mobile app deployments.

name: Other / unclassified
description: The incident does not match any known category and needs manual triage.

fallback_hypothesis.title: Recent change or unknown dependency failure
fallback_hypothesis.reasoning: No known incident pattern matched, so the most common generic causes are checked first.
next_steps: Review deployments and configuration changes made shortly before the incident started.
In ELK, compare error rates per service for the incident window against the previous day.
Escalate to the owning team of the most affected service for manual triage.
